title: Facit Lock
description: A baseline snapshot taken when the implementation matches the facit 100%. Records, per facit node id, the content-hash that was proven and the tests that prove it. Future iteration diffs the live facit against this lock: only nodes whose hash changed (or are new/removed) need re-proving — everything else stays proven-since-lock. This is the spec-lock and the E13 criterion-coverage instrument.

facitHash.description: Canonical hash of the whole facit at lock time.

nodes.description: Map of facit node id (story or AC) -> its proven state at lock time.

hash.description: Content-hash of the node's canonical text at lock time. A change here means the node changed since the lock.

tests.description: Test ids proving this node at lock time.
